blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Three times the quantity x plus two, plus x, equals two x plus twenty. Solve for x.
Distribute the three. Three x plus six, plus x, equals two x plus twenty.
Combine like terms on the left: three x plus x is four x. Four x plus six equals two x plus twenty.
Subtract two x from both sides. Two x plus six equals twenty.
Subtract six from both sides. Two x equals fourteen.
Divide both sides by two. x equals seven.
Watch out for these traps. If you multiply the three by x but not by two, you get nine. If you add two x instead of subtracting it, you get seven over three.
